title: Bloom Energy's AI Data Center Backlog Just Grew Again -- Here's What It's Worth
byline: Reuben Gregg Brewer, The Motley Fool
excerpt: Bloom Energy's backlog increased in the second quarter, but the real power in the backlog isn't product sales.
content_html:
Bloom Energy (NYSE: BE) only provides a dollar figure for its backlog once per year. At the start of 2026, the backlog was $20 billion. That's a huge figure that's likely even higher today. In the company's second-quarter update, Bloom noted that it has new customers that aren't yet in the backlog figure. And that its backlog is growing faster than its revenues!

But there's an important nuance to consider about the backlog when evaluating Bloom Energy as an investment.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

As a business, Bloom Energy is incredibly well-positioned right now. It makes hydrogen fuel cells that can provide off-grid power. The demand for electricity from the artificial intelligence build-out is straining the grid's capacity to deliver power, with companies increasingly turning to alternatives like Bloom Energy's fuel cells.

AI-driven demand is a key reason why the backlog rose to $20 billion at the start of 2026. But there's a nuance in that number. The company's product backlog rose 140% year over year, highlighting the strong demand for its products. Only that backlog was just $6 billion of the total backlog. Selling new fuel cells is clearly a very important factor to monitor, but it isn't the long-term growth engine investors may believe it is.

The rest of the backlog, or roughly $14 billion at the start of 2026, was related to services. Every new fuel cell sold comes along with a service contract. That revenue is annuity-like, and the service backlog grows with each new fuel cell sold. This is the true flywheel of the business, with the company's services business profitable since 2024, even though the company itself wasn't profitable in 2024 or 2025 due to losses in other parts of the operation.

Bloom Energy: Everything appears to be working together now

That said, AI demand appears to have changed the dynamic in 2026. The company was profitable in the first and second quarters of the year, with increasing demand suggesting that future quarters will be strong as well. And each new fuel cell sold augments the services backlog, which improves Bloom Energy's long-term outlook.

The only problem is that investors appear to be pricing in a lot of good news already. The stock is up nearly 500% over the past year as of this writing, including the recent 35% drawdown. Bloom Energy has an attractive story, but only the most aggressive growth investors should consider it. And, even then, you'll need to believe strongly in the AI growth story to justify buying after such a rapid and large price move.

content_html_zh:
Bloom Energy（纽约证券交易所代码：BE）每年仅提供一次积压订单的美元数据。 2026 年初，积压金额为 200 亿美元。 这是一个巨大的数字，今天可能还会更高。 在该公司第二季度的更新中，布鲁姆指出，它有一些新客户尚未出现在积压订单中。 而且其积压订单的增长速度超过了收入的增长速度！

但在评估布鲁姆能源公司作为一项投资时，需要考虑积压的一个重要细微差别。

错过了 2009 年的 Nvidia？ 这个罕见的信号再次闪烁。 2009年，一家名不见经传的芯片制造商英伟达发出了“双倍下跌”的信号。 多年来，对于一家规模仅为 Nvidia 1/100 的公司来说，同样的“完全确信”信号闪烁。 继续 ”

作为一家企业，布鲁姆能源目前处于令人难以置信的有利地位。 它生产可以提供离网电力的氢燃料电池。 人工智能建设对电力的需求正在对电网的供电能力造成压力，越来越多的公司转向使用布鲁姆能源公司的燃料电池等替代方案。

人工智能驱动的需求是 2026 年初积压订单升至 200 亿美元的关键原因。 但这个数字有一个细微差别。 该公司的产品积压量同比增长140%，凸显其产品的强劲需求。 仅该积压订单仅占总积压订单的 60 亿美元。 销售新燃料电池显然是一个非常重要的监控因素，但它并不是投资者所认为的长期增长引擎。

其余积压订单（到 2026 年初约为 140 亿美元）与服务相关。 每售出的新燃料电池都附有一份服务合同。 该收入类似于年金，并且随着每售出一个新燃料电池，服务积压也会增加。 这是该业务真正的飞轮，该公司的服务业务自 2024 年以来就实现了盈利，尽管该公司本身由于其他业务部门的亏损而在 2024 年或 2025 年没有实现盈利。

Bloom Energy：现在一切似乎都在协同工作

也就是说，人工智能需求似乎在 2026 年改变了动态。 该公司在今年第一和第二季度实现了盈利，需求的增加表明未来几个季度也将表现强劲。 每售出一个新的燃料电池都会增加服务积压，从而改善 Bloom Energy 的长期前景。

唯一的问题是，投资者似乎已经消化了很多好消息。 截至撰写本文时，该股在过去一年中上涨了近 500%，其中最近下跌了 35%。 布鲁姆能源公司的故事很吸引人，但只有最激进的成长型投资者才应该考虑它。 而且，即便如此，您也需要坚信人工智能的增长故事，才能在如此快速和大幅的价格波动后证明购买的合理性。
